honours.name: Oprah Winfrey
honours.who: For using her platform for lasting impact

honours.name: AB InBev
honours.who: Third time — a festival first · CMO Marcel Marcondes

honours.name: Eddy Cue
honours.who: Apple · in conversation with Jerry Bruckheimer

talks.read: Resisted being called a 'brand' for years, then reframed it as 'just an expression of yourself.' Her operating principle: set an intention before every show and check afterwards whether you met it. Told the Whitney Houston story — protecting a vulnerable guest over a ratings win — to argue trust can't be performed, only earned.

talks.talk: Five marketing truths we can actually agree on
talks.read: Two famous antagonists agreed, for once, on five fundamentals: mental availability does ~70–80% of marketing's job; distinctive brand assets are the mechanism (Ritson retired his own term 'brand codes' live on stage); sophisticated mass beats niche; brand purpose is largely nonsense; and consistency is undervalued — campaigns die at 30–40 days when they should run far longer.

talks.talk: AI and a new era of creative risk-taking
talks.spk: Demis Hassabis · Google DeepMind, with A24
talks.read: The festival's headline AI session: DeepMind's Demis Hassabis joined indie film studio A24 to argue AI will usher in a 'new era of creative risk-taking' — framing the technology as a spur to bolder creative bets rather than a replacement for film-makers. A more optimistic counterpoint to the week's 'credibility over hype' mood.

talks.talk: Advertising in the age of AI
talks.read: OpenAI's first Cannes, a coming-out for its ad business: 'We're clearly in the advertising business now.' Pitched ChatGPT ads (labelled, below answers, on free tiers) and a shift from an 'attention economy' to an 'intelligence economy,' with a Codex demo building a dealership campaign without code. Read by some as visionary, by others as a self-serving platform pitch.

Despite the title, Pritchard embraced the AI future — running a custom 'ChatPG' bot on stage and showing Pantene assets made 5× faster at a fifth of the cost. His real argument: every brand manager can now move like a DTC founder, with AI doing the heavy lifting while humans keep the insight (his Fairy 'Skip the Soak' fix being the human part). Brand-building, in his telling, increasingly proven by retail sales.

Apple TV's philosophy in Cue's words: 'we've never strived to be the most — we strive to be the best.' The news: he and Bruckheimer teased a second F1 film (Apple's biggest movie to date) and a new UAP/UFO conspiracy thriller with F1 director Joseph Kosinski. A warm, long-term-thinking conversation on backing storytellers.

talks.talk: Creative Marketer of the Year keynote
talks.read: The opening keynote, with AB InBev a record third-time winner. Five plain lessons: dream big but stay humble; solve real business and consumer problems; consistency compounds ('for the long term it's gold'); go beyond ads into experiences; and tech enables but this stays a human business — his 'Justice League' of agency partners doing the work.
